text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"དེ་ཡང་ཐབས་གཞན་གྱིས་རྟོགས་པ་མ་ཡིན་པས་འཇིག་རྟེན་པའི་ལྷན་ཅིག་སྐྱེས་པའི་དགའ་བ་ཉིད་ལ་མན་ངག་ཇི་ལྟ་བར་ལྷག་པར་མོས་པས་བསྒོམ་པ་ཡོངས་སུ་རྫོགས་པ་ནི་མངོན་དུ་གྱུར་པས་བདག་ཉིད་ཀྱིས་ཤེས་སོ།","english":"the perfection of meditation through superior devotion to the oral instructions on the worldly co-emergent joy itself leads to manifestation, which is known by oneself.","kind":"sense","why":"The source says the worldly joy is NOT the object to be accomplished, but the English implies it is the object of meditation.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: the perfection of meditation through superior devotion to the oral instructions on the worldly co-emergent joy itself leads to manifestation, which is known by oneself.
contradictions.why: The source says the worldly joy is NOT the object to be accomplished, but the English implies it is the object of meditation.
